title: The British Art Prize 2026
description: Enter up to 20 original artworks for a £2,000 top prize, a London solo exhibition, and Artists & Illustrators coverage.
descriptionDetailed: The British Art Prize, run by Artists & Illustrators magazine, is an annual art competition open to artists of every level. All styles, media, and techniques are considered, except AI-generated works. Winners receive prizes worth more than £10,000, including a £2,000 first prize and a solo London exhibition.

entry.feeNote: Entry is £24 for the first artwork and £19 for each additional artwork, with up to 20 works permitted per artist

prize.description: First prize is £2,000 cash plus a solo exhibition at Panter & Hall's Cecil Court Gallery, a bundle of STAEDTLER art materials, and a six-page feature in Artists & Illustrators. Second prize is £500 cash with £750 of Derwent art materials. Third prize is £750 of Royal Talens products. The Raw Umber Studios Prize for Portraiture awards £750 cash, and the People's Choice Award provides £1,000 of Clairefontaine products. The full prize package is worth more than £10,000.

audience.eligibilityLabel: Open to all artists worldwide, amateur to professional
audience.eligibilityDetail: Open to everyone - amateur, emerging, and professional artists from any country. All styles, media, and techniques are considered, excluding works generated by AI. Artists may enter up to 20 works, and selected artists must be able to provide the physical artwork for the exhibition stage.
